decisions.reason: The temporary Calendly destination applies only to the Book a Session button and does not change homepage portfolio tiles linking to the gallery.
The source concerns the separate Book a Session button; the existing Gallery, Pricing, and Services button destinations remain unchanged.
Selecting Calendly temporarily for session booking does not affect square-footage pricing tiers or package prices.
The Book a Session destination decision does not alter the source, placement, or use of client-supplied website imagery.
The Calendly link decision is unrelated to the gallery portfolio video's asset, placement, or behavior.
The source does not change the homepage hero overlay's color, opacity, or visual emphasis.
The Book a Session link destination has no effect on portfolio hover-animation behavior or its device policy.
The temporary Calendly destination does not alter the required count or presentation of pricing bundles.
The session-booking decision does not change the gallery's image source, quantity, or collection.
The Book a Session destination decision does not affect the mobile pricing table's horizontal-scrolling layout.
